prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that 2025 spring trip—starting out in Beijing and then heading down to Shanghai, it felt like such a blur.
The funny part is my friend kept bragging she grabbed us train D321 for 2025-03-02, so I didn’t have to deal with any of it.
And the ticket was under Li Na, First Class too—honestly it was way nicer than I expected for a daytime ride.
Once we got to Shanghai, I remember chatting about hotels there nonstop, like we were suddenly all travel critics.
We actually stayed at Home Inn the Bund—check-in was 2025-03-04 for 3 nights, and it was booked under Liu Yang.
Oh, and that reservation name—Liu Yang—still cracks me up because the front desk kept repeating it like it was a VIP thing.

After Shanghai I swung by Chengdu; people kept recommending attractions there, and I even remember someone arranging a Chengdu home service visit for 2025-03-05 in the morning at Room 203, Building C, West Apartment—phone 13867894321—and they showed up in a luxury car type ride, which felt wildly extra.
